evals.prompt: Build a simple card component in HTML and CSS. The card has a header image, a title, body text, and a footer with a CTA button. Include a 'featured' variant that highlights the card. Name everything correctly.
evals.expected_output: HTML uses dash-case attributes. CSS uses c- prefix with BEM structure: c-card, c-card__header, c-card__title, c-card__body, c-card__footer, c-card--featured. All names are dash-case. Button uses c- prefix, not unstyled or utility-classed.
expectations: Block class uses c- prefix (e.g. c-card)
Element classes use BEM double underscore (e.g. c-card__header, c-card__title)
Modifier class uses BEM double dash (e.g. c-card--featured)
All class names are dash-case — no camelCase or snake_case in CSS classes
No class names spelled out with 'component-', 'block-', or other non-c- prefixes
HTML attributes and values are dash-case

evals.prompt: I'm adding JavaScript behavior to a modal component in the mmn design system. I need: a variable to track whether the modal is open, a function to close it, a class name to hook the JS behavior onto, and a custom data attribute to store the modal's ID.
evals.expected_output: Variable uses camelCase (isModalOpen). Function uses camelCase (closeModal). JS hook class uses js- prefix (js-mmn-modal). Data attribute uses data-mmn-modal-id format.
expectations: Variable name is camelCase (e.g. isModalOpen or modalIsOpen)
Function name is camelCase (e.g. closeModal)
JS hook class uses the js- prefix (e.g. js-mmn-modal)
JS hook class is not styled — it exists only as a selector
Data attribute follows data-namespace-attribute pattern (e.g. data-mmn-modal-id)

evals.prompt: I need a CSS class that makes a grid utility full-width, but only from the lg breakpoint and up. What should the class be named, and write the CSS for it?
evals.expected_output: Class uses u- prefix, @from-lg suffix (not min-lg, bp-lg, or from-large). The responsive suffix is appended directly to the class name.
expectations: Class uses u- prefix for a utility (e.g. u-mmn-full-width@from-lg)
Uses @from-lg suffix — not min-lg, from-large, bp-lg, or any other pattern
Does not use a spelled-out breakpoint name like 'from-large' or 'from-xlarge'
The responsive suffix is part of the class name, not a separate modifier

evals.prompt: Define CSS custom properties for the primary button background color and border radius in the mmn project. Define one as a global design token and one scoped to the button component.
evals.expected_output: Global token uses --mmn-color-bg-primary. Scoped component property uses --c-mmn-button-border-radius. Both are dash-case. The scoped one includes the c- prefix to signal component scope.
expectations: Global token follows --namespace-category-name pattern (e.g. --mmn-color-bg-primary)
Scoped token follows --prefix-namespace-block-property pattern (e.g. --c-mmn-button-border-radius)
Background is abbreviated as bg — not background, brand-, surface-, or color-
Both properties are dash-case
The scoped property includes the c- prefix before the namespace

evals.expected_output: Properties reordered into the correct groups: display/flex properties first, then position, then size, then space (padding), then typography (font-size, color), then border (border-radius, box-shadow), then background, then advanced (transition). z-index comes after position.
expectations: display comes before flex-direction, align-items, and gap
position and z-index come after the display/flex group
padding comes after position properties
font-size and color come after spacing (padding)
border-radius and box-shadow come after typography
background-color comes after border properties
transition is last, in the advanced group
